spaces.title: Churn, pricing pages and the one email that worked

spaceCaptions.text: Welcome in. We'll do twenty minutes on churn, then open the floor.
Our biggest drop was month two. People set it up and never came back.
Same. We added a week-one check-in and month two got better.
The email that worked was three lines, and a reply button. No discount.
